title: Innoviz Technologies to cut 20% of workforce
summary: Israeli automotive sensor maker Innoviz Technologies plans to lay off 80 employees, representing around 20 per cent of its workforce, as delays in a major automotive programme put pressure on its revenue and cash position. llm_summary: Innoviz Technologies, the Israeli maker of lidar sensors for autonomous vehicles, announced it will cut about 20 % of its staff—80 jobs—after delays in a key automotive program strained its revenue and cash flow. The layoffs will bring the workforce down to under 300 employees, following two earlier rounds of reductions. This move reflects the broader challenges the company faces in scaling its technology amid a slowing auto‑industry rollout.
